{{Short description|None}}
{{China divisions by}}

The article lists [[China]]'s [[Province-level divisions of China|first-level]] [[administrative divisions of China|administrative divisions]] by [[gross domestic product]] (GDP). Each province's GDP is listed in both the national currency [[renminbi]] (CNY), and at nominal [[United States dollar|U.S. dollar]] values according to annual average exchange rates. [[Purchasing power parity]] (PPP) indicators, measured in [[international dollar]]s fluctuate frequently, and its relevant data is not included in the main table, only included at the end of the entry. PPP reference comes from the [[World Economic Outlook]] published by the [[International Monetary Fund]] (IMF). The [[list of renminbi exchange rates|average CNY exchange rate]] used here is from the [[National Bureau of Statistics of China|China NBS]], and [[List of renminbi exchange rates#List of purchasing power parity exchange rates|CNY PPP exchange rates]] are estimated according to the IMF.

== References ==
{{Reflist|refs=

<ref name="ExRate">For the exchange rate of 2025, refer to chl.cn {{cite press release | url=https://chl.cn/huilv/?usd-2025| title=zh: 2025年美元汇率| publisher=chl.cn|access-date=March 11, 2026}};  Refer to the national statistical database for the historical exchange rates {{cite press release | url=https://data.stats.gov.cn/english| title=national data - annual - foreign tarde and economic cooperation - reference exchange rate of renminbi (period average)| publisher=China NBS| date=April 2026|access-date=May 5, 2026}}, and for the historical exchange rates also published on the statistical yearbooks {{cite press release | url=http://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/ndsj| title=statistical yearbooks (Chinese / English)| publisher=China NBS|date=March 2026|access-date=May 5, 2026}}</ref>

<ref name="China NBS GDP data">最新年份人均GDP基于各省统计公报公布的当年末人口与上年末人口平均数计算。其他历史年份各省人均GDP参考China NBS数据库。The latest GDP per capita figures are calculated based on the average of the year-end population published in the provincial statistical communiqué for that year and the year-end population for the previous year. For other historical years, GDP per capita for each province is referenced from the China NBS database. refer to China NBS National data {{cite press release | url=https://data.stats.gov.cn/english| title=regional - Annual by province - national accounts - gross regional product| publisher=China NBS|access-date=May 5, 2026}}</ref>

<ref name="IMFPPP">Purchasing power parity index reference: World Economic Outlook published in April, 2026 by [[International Monetary Fund]] {{cite press release | url=https://data.imf.org/en/datasets/IMF.RES:WEO | title=April 2026 World Economic Outlook | publisher=IMF |access-date= May 5, 2026}}</ref>

<ref name="5th-economic-census">The economic data for 2023 and previous years were revised based on the 5th National Economic Census in 2023 and released by the National Bureau of Statistics of China {{cite press release | url=https://www.stats.gov.cn/english/PressRelease/202501/t20250117_1958330.html| title=National Economy Witnessed Steady Progress amidst Stability with Major Development Targets Achieved Successfully in 2024| publisher=China NBS| date=April 2025| access-date=November 19, 2025}}.</ref>

<ref name="hmt">Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan exist as separate customs territories, and their social and economic development indicators are not included in China's data. All data concerning these regions here references the IMF's April 2026 World Economic Outlook; referenced from the IMF April 2026 World Economic Outlook, refer to WEO {{cite press release | url=https://data.imf.org/en/datasets/IMF.RES:WEO | title=April 2026 World Economic Outlook | publisher=IMF |access-date= May 5, 2026}} Their GDP data for Hong Kong and Macau are based on data released by the IMF; actual GDP per capita is calculated at year-end population. For the annual average exchange rate of local currency to Chinese yuan (CN¥‌), refer to chl.cn {{cite press release | url=https://chl.cn/huilv/ | title=zh: 汇率 | publisher=chl.cn|access-date= May 5, 2026}}; GDP figures based on local currency, US dollar, and purchasing power parity over the years, referenced from the IMF April 2026 World Economic Outlook<br>
